home.title: StriveFormats | Fix Shopify & Ecommerce CSV Import Errors
home.description: Fix product CSVs for Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, eBay and Amazon in your browser. Safe fixes are automatic, risky ones are flagged by row and cell. Free to try, no sign-up.
home.faq1Q: Do you upload my CSV to a server?
home.faq1A: No. Reading, fixing and exporting the file all happen in your browser, and its contents are never sent anywhere. We only record anonymous usage events (for example, that a file was checked) and, if you're signed in, how many exports you've used.
home.faq2Q: What kinds of problems can it fix automatically?
home.faq2A: Safe fixes include price and number formats, true/false values, URL handles, extra spaces and inherited product fields on variant rows. Anything that could change meaning, such as duplicate SKUs or a blank cell that would erase data, is flagged for you to review.
home.faq3A: Custom Formats let you save the columns and cleanup rules of a file you handle regularly, so every new copy is checked the same way. Creating and using them requires the Advanced plan.
home.faq4Q: Can I cancel or change plans later?
home.faq4A: Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade or cancel at any time from your profile page.
home.upgradeModalMessage: Custom Formats are available on the Advanced plan. Upgrade to create and manage reusable CSV formats.
home.heroBadge: Free to try · runs in your browser
home.heroDesc: Upload a Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, eBay or Amazon file. Safe problems are fixed automatically, risky ones are pointed out by row and cell, and you export a file that imports cleanly.
home.howTitle: Three steps to a clean import
home.step1Desc: Choose Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, eBay, Amazon or one of your own formats, then drop in the CSV. Big files are processed in the background so the page stays responsive.
home.step2Desc: Every issue points to a row and column and explains why the platform would reject it. Safe fixes, such as price formats, true/false values and URL handles, are already applied.
home.step3Desc: Download the fixed file and a log of every change. Only downloads count toward the free limit.
home.before1: Prices like "$ 45" or "18,00" that the importer rejects
home.before2: Variant rows that lost their product handle
home.before3: Blank cells that silently erase existing product data
home.before4: Import errors that don't say which row is wrong
home.after1: Prices, weights and true/false values in the format the platform expects
home.after2: Variants grouped under the right product
home.after3: A warning before anything gets overwritten
home.after4: Each problem pinned to its exact row and cell
home.fixerDesc: Pick a platform and upload your CSV. The fixer applies the safe fixes, flags the risky ones, and lets you edit the remaining cells right in the table before you export.
home.feat1Desc: Prices, booleans, handles, whitespace and option values are normalised without changing what they mean.
home.feat2Desc: Duplicate SKUs, missing variant options and overwrite risks are shown for you to decide.
home.feat3Desc: Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, eBay and Amazon, plus a converter that moves products between them.
home.customDesc: Describe the columns and cleanup rules of a file you handle regularly once, then check every new copy of it in one click.
home.cf1Desc: Create a format from the headers of a CSV you already have.
home.cf2Desc: Required values, allowed values, trimming, letter case and number formats.
home.cf3Desc: Export a format as a file and import it on another device or for a teammate.
home.safe1Desc: Parsing, fixing and exporting happen in your browser. Your product data is never uploaded.
home.safe2Desc: Every automatic change is listed in the fix log, and anything that could change meaning waits for your decision.
home.safe3Desc: Workspaces, custom formats and the converter help when you update a catalogue regularly.
home.pricingTitle: Start free. Upgrade when you need more.
home.pricingDesc: No card and no account needed to try it. Paid plans add more exports and custom formats.
home.faq5Q: What does the free plan include?
home.faq5A: Every check and fix is free. Downloading the fixed file counts as an export, and you get {count} exports a month without an account. Basic raises that to 100 a month and Advanced removes the limit.

inspector.title: CSV Inspector
inspector.description: Upload a CSV file to get an instant analysis of its structure, headers, and potential issues.
inspector.noIssues: No structural issues found. The file is well-formed CSV.
inspector.privacyNote: Your file is processed in your browser. It is not uploaded to a server.
inspector.unclosedQuoteDesc: A quoted cell is never closed, so everything after it was read as one cell. Look for a stray " character in the last rows of the file.
inspector.hintBom: The file starts with a byte order mark (BOM). Shopify and most tools handle it, but some older importers read it as part of the first header.
inspector.hintReplacement: Some characters could not be decoded (shown as �). The file was probably not saved as UTF-8. Re-save it as "CSV UTF-8".
inspector.hintMojibake: Some accented characters look garbled (for example "Ã©" instead of "é"). The file was saved in one encoding and opened in another. Re-save it as "CSV UTF-8".
inspector.hintCp1252: The file contains Windows-1252 control characters, so it may not be valid UTF-8. Re-save it as "CSV UTF-8".
inspector.duplicateHeadersDesc: Importers usually keep only one of the columns that share a name, so the data in the others is lost.
inspector.emptyHeadersDesc: Column positions: {cols}. Most importers reject or ignore unnamed columns.
inspector.paddedHeadersDesc: Spaces before or after a header name stop many importers from recognising the column.
inspector.emptyColumnsDesc: These columns are empty in every row. On Shopify, importing an empty column over existing products clears those values, so delete the column if you don't mean to change it.
inspector.inconsistentDesc: These rows have a different number of cells than the header row. This is usually caused by an unquoted delimiter or a missing quote.
inspector.nextSteps: Want to fix the issues? The CSV Fixer validates the file against your platform's rules and fixes what it safely can.
